"Arms" is a song written and performed by American singer-songwriter Christina Perri, and was the second single released from her 2011 debut album Lovestrong.
The song debuted on the Billboard Hot 100 at number 94.
The song's accompanying music video debuted on April 28, 2011 on VH1.
Lovestrong (stylized as lovestrong.) is the debut studio album by American singer-songwriter Christina Perri.
It was released on June 10, 2011, via Atlantic Records.
After premiering on So You Think You Can Dance, the lead single "Jar of Hearts" peaked on the Billboard Hot 100 at 17 and was certified double platinum by the RIAA.
